title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS001
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
- Project is a concentrated solar power facility.
- Vendor must fabricate all pipe spools for HTF piping.
- Items like bolts, gaskets, and valves are not shop furnished.
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Confidential information must be handled according to contract terms.
- Socket weld joints cannot be radiographed; visual inspection required.
- Vendor responsible for cleaning pipe spools and adhering to specific standards.
- Fabricator must maintain cleanliness during fabrication process.
- Root pass welds must use TIG/Heliarc welding process.
- Vendor must provide detailed drawing prints with FW and FFW locations.
summary_points: Project is a concentrated solar power facility.
Vendor must fabricate all pipe spools for HTF piping.
Items like bolts, gaskets, and valves are not shop furnished.
Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Confidential information must be handled according to contract terms.
Socket weld joints cannot be radiographed; visual inspection required.
Vendor responsible for cleaning pipe spools and adhering to specific standards.
Fabricator must maintain cleanliness during fabrication process.
Root pass welds must use TIG/Heliarc welding process.
Vendor must provide detailed drawing prints with FW and FFW locations.
All foreign matter must be removed before and after welding.
Piping must be cleaned and painted as per specified standards.
The document outlines engineering standards and practices for piping shop fabrication at Solana.
It includes specifications for protecting flanged ends, special considerations for different types of piping systems, and fabrication tolerances.
Confidentiality measures are in place to protect proprietary information.
Alternate billing cycles can be requested by the owner.
